hero_kpi_rationale: Key metric in the insurance sector reflecting growth in insurance and reinsurance activities with $12.7B in net written premiums in 2025, growing 5.5% year-on-year

kpis.explanation_en: Net premiums written by the company across all its activities
kpis.description: Net premiums written by the consolidated insurance company for the Insurance and Reinsurance segments

kpis.explanation_en: Net premiums written by the company for the insurance segment
kpis.description: Net premiums written by the company for the insurance segment, representing 88% of total activity
kpis.signal: Growth in net written premiums for the insurance segment (88% of total)

kpis.explanation_en: Net premiums written by the company for the monoline excess reinsurance segment
kpis.description: Net premiums written by the company for the Monoline Excess Reinsurance segment, representing 12% of total activity
kpis.signal: Growth in net written premiums for the reinsurance segment (12% of total)

kpis.explanation_en: Sum of the loss ratio and expense ratio; below 100 indicates an underwriting profit.
kpis.description: The consolidated combined ratio stands at 90.7% in 2025 compared to 90.3% in 2024, reflecting an increase in the loss ratio (+0.6 pt), partially offset by an improvement in the expense ratio (-0.2 pt). Underwriting profitability remains robust.

kpis.explanation_en: Income generated by the invested asset portfolio net of management fees, excluding realized gains/losses.
kpis.description: Net investment income rose 7% to $1,429M in 2025, primarily due to a larger bond portfolio (+$47M) and recovery in investment funds (+$39M). The average annualized return remained stable at 4.5%.

kpis.explanation_en: Net income attributable to common shareholders divided by the weighted average number of diluted shares.
kpis.description: Diluted EPS reached $4.45 in 2025 compared to $4.36 in 2024, supported by higher net income (+$23M) and a reduction in shares outstanding (-3.4M shares through buybacks). Organic growth and capital discipline combine favorably.

kpis.explanation_en: Total gross premiums underwritten before reinsurance cessions, reflecting total business volume.
kpis.description: Gross premiums written increased by 6% to $15,105 million in 2025, driven by insurance (+$803 million) and reinsurance (+$91 million). Average renewal rate increases were 6.7%, with an 81% retention rate.

kpis.explanation_en: Incurred losses and loss adjustment expenses relative to net earned premiums; measures the technical quality of underwriting.
kpis.description: The consolidated loss ratio was 62.4% in 2025, compared to 61.8% in 2024. Net catastrophe losses reached $336M (vs $298M in 2024), primarily driven by wildfires in California. Excluding catastrophes and reserve development, the underlying ratio increased by 0.6 pts to 59.8%.
Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.09 last year.

kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of 0.7 Bn $ in the last year.

kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 39.4% last year.

kpis.explanation_en: Net income divided by the average number of diluted shares during the fiscal year. Measures the company's ability to generate earnings per share: used as the basis for the Payout Ratio (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: Historique 5 ans (2021-2025). Source : yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).

risks.title: Fluctuations cycliques du secteur assurance
risks.title_en: Cyclical fluctuations in the insurance sector
risks.summary: Insurance demand is primarily driven by economic conditions, while supply is linked to available capacity. These fluctuations affect premium rates and profitability
risks.summary_en: Insurance demand primarily depends on economic conditions while supply is tied to available capacity. These fluctuations affect premium rates and profitability.
risks.score_rationale: The company's results are subject to significant fluctuations due to cyclical changes in the insurance and reinsurance markets. Supply and demand factors directly impact underwriting profitability.
risks.score_rationale_en: The company's results are subject to significant fluctuations due to cyclical changes in the insurance and reinsurance markets. Supply and demand factors directly impact operational profitability.

risks.title: Catastrophes naturelles et événements extrêmes
risks.summary: The frequency and severity of claims from natural disasters directly impact the adequacy of premium rates and loss reserves
risks.summary_en: The frequency and severity of claims due to natural catastrophes directly impact the adequacy of premium rates and loss reserves.
risks.score_rationale: Natural disasters and extreme events can have a significant impact on the company's results. Catastrophic losses are inherently unpredictable and potentially substantial for insurers.
risks.score_rationale_en: Natural catastrophes and extreme events can have a significant impact on the company's results. Catastrophe losses are inherently unpredictable and potentially substantial for insurers.

risks.title: Uncertainty regarding ultimate claim costs
risks.summary: Premium rate adequacy is affected by loss severity and frequency, influenced by catastrophes, regulatory decisions, and inflation.
risks.summary_en: The adequacy of premium rates is affected by claim severity and frequency, influenced by catastrophes, regulatory decisions, and inflation.
risks.score_rationale: Premium rates are set before the actual claim costs are known. The uncertainty of ultimate costs results from numerous external factors including economic and social inflation, judicial decisions, and regulatory changes.
risks.score_rationale_en: Premium rates are set before actual claim costs are known. Uncertainty in ultimate costs arises from numerous external factors including economic and social inflation, judicial decisions, and regulatory changes.

risks.title: Climate change and rising climate-related risks
risks.title_en: Climate change and increasing climate risks
risks.summary: The increasing frequency and severity of natural disasters related to climate change represent a major risk to profitability.
risks.summary_en: The increasing frequency and severity of climate-related natural catastrophes represent a major risk to profitability.
risks.score_rationale: Climate change may increase the frequency and severity of natural disasters, directly impacting the company's financial results through larger and more frequent claims.
risks.score_rationale_en: Climate change may increase the frequency and severity of natural catastrophes, directly impacting the company's results through larger and more frequent claims.

risks.title: Claims reserves risks
risks.summary: Loss and loss expense reserve estimates represent complex management judgment subject to material revisions as additional claims emerge.
risks.summary_en: Estimates of loss reserves and associated expenses involve complex managerial judgment and are subject to material revisions as additional claims emerge.
risks.score_rationale: Claims reserves are based on complex and subjective estimates using actuarial data. Reserve deficiencies or redundancies may significantly impact future results when estimates are revised.
risks.score_rationale_en: Loss reserves are based on complex and subjective estimates using actuarial data. Reserve deficiencies or redundancies can significantly impact future results when estimates are revised.

risks.title: Terrorism and malicious acts risks
risks.summary: Certified acts of terrorism are an insured risk with potentially limited coverage depending on federal certification.
risks.summary_en: Certified acts of terrorism represent an insurable risk with potentially limited coverage depending on federal certification.
risks.score_rationale: Acts of terrorism certified by the U.S. Secretary of the Treasury may result in significant losses. Coverage for these risks is subject to legal and regulatory limitations.
risks.score_rationale_en: Acts of terrorism certified by the U.S. Secretary of the Treasury can generate significant claims. Coverage for these risks is subject to legal and regulatory limitations.

risks.title: Concurrence accrue et pression tarifaire
risks.summary: The availability of insurance capacity and competition influence premium rates and underwriting profitability
risks.summary_en: The availability of insurance capacity and competition influence premium rates and the profitability of insurance operations.
risks.score_rationale: Competition in the commercial insurance sector may create downward pricing pressure, affecting profitability even with growth in written premium volumes.
risks.score_rationale_en: Competition in the commercial insurance sector may create downward pricing pressure, affecting profitability even with growth in written premium volumes.
